author: PsychoStoner
body:

Be f*cking careful out there, by out there I mean in the real world. There is a lot of really wired f*ucked up sh*t that happens and people see it as ok. There's are alot of wired stuff out there and like I said f*cked up shit, especially on the Internet. Be careful stay safe.
